tasks.DefineVariables: Define variables for the amount of money Arjun (A) and Sajal (S) have initially.
tasks.FormulateEquation1: Formulate an equation based on the first condition where if Arun gives $30 to Sajal, Sajal will have twice the money left with Arjun.
tasks.FormulateEquation2: Formulate an equation based on the second condition where if Sajal gives $10 to Arjun, Arjun will have thrice as much as is left with Sajal.
tasks.SolveSystemOfEquations: Solve the system of equations derived from both conditions to find the initial amounts of money each has.
